name: José Luiz Benício
description: José Luiz Benício da Fonseca, known as Benício , was a Brazilian illustrator and designer born on December 14, 1936 , in Rio Pardo, Brazil . He became famous for his work in advertising, book covers, and movie posters , particularly during the 1960s and 70s. His illustrations often featured voluptuous women , earning him the title of the "master of Brazilian pin-ups" . Benício created over 300 movie posters , including iconic works for Brazilian cinema, such as Dona Flor e Seus Dois Maridos . He also designed thousands of book covers , notably for the Brigitte Montfort spy series. His career spanned more than 50 years , influencing Brazilian visual culture through his distinctive style. He passed away on December 7, 2021 , leaving behind a lasting artistic legacy Showcase images were created with ComfyUI and are in PNG, include metadata & workflow. The idea is to use this model, combined with others, to create new styles of digital art expression.
